labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Asks to widen the type of an existing Table parameter; a feature-style change.

items.body:
This is a feature request to widen the type of `Table(title=...)`. Per the [feature request template](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md), new features need approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened.

Existing ways to get a rule-style separator at the table's width are the Table.grid approach or a `Text` sized to the table, as described in the report. A closely related earlier issue, #4171, was closed as not planned.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
